title: dactylorhiza elata f. leucantha
intro: Dactylorhiza elata f. leucantha, commonly known as the white-flowered orchid, is a plant species within the orchid family (Orchidaceae) and a subvariant of Dactylorhiza elata, a type of terrestrial orchid. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Studies suggest that Dactylorhiza elata f. leucantha exhibits therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antibacterial, and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
